categories_thin: Nail salons - backfilled but still thin: the town-wide salon directory carries only 3 nail listings, Booksy's New Brunswick nail page surfaced 1 bookable salon, and the phone-book directories (Yellow Pages, SuperPages) that carry the rest block direct fetching. Total now 7 including Versailles Beauty Spa and Blessed Beauty K&M.

Veterinary - only Paulus Animal Hospital sits inside the town boundary; the nearest others (Hidden Lake in North Brunswick, Cedar Lane in Somerset, Raritan in Edison, VCA Edgebrook in East Brunswick) are outside New Brunswick and were not added.

Optometry - three practices now (Weininger, Optical Boutique, Comprehensive Eye Care Professionals), and the latter two share one suite at 1 Spring St, so the town may really have only two independent optometry businesses.

Med spas / aesthetics - Luminous Aesthetic is the only clearly New Brunswick-based injectable clinic found, and even its NJ address could not be confirmed on a live page. Plastic Surgery Arts of New Jersey markets a New Brunswick (409 Joyce Kilmer Ave) Botox service, but its own site's location list names Edison, East Brunswick, Princeton and Skillman only, so it was not added.

Mental health - group practices are few; the long tail is solo licensed clinicians listed one by one on Psychology Today, which would be hundreds of individual practitioners rather than businesses, so they were not enumerated.

Gyms / fitness - the NJ gym directory lists 7 New Brunswick fitness centers and 6 are Rutgers or RWJBarnabas facilities (excluded), leaving The PR Lab as the only independent one; yoga/Pilates and martial arts are covered separately.

Dental - 17 dental practices are now listed, up from 9. Several further directory names resolve to an address already covered by another entry (Lanny Rubin at University Dental Care; Rutgers Health University Dental Associates and the Dental Implants & Surgery listing at 135 Somerset St; Salim Nathoo at the excluded Eric B. Chandler site) or to practices actually located outside the town (Luz M. Nieto in North Plainfield, Lealon Robinson in Newark/Boonton, KK Dental in North Brunswick/Somerset/Edison), so the practical ceiling inside the town boundary is close.
caveats: Chains, franchises and brand-franchise affiliates deliberately excluded even though they show up in searches: JAG Physical Therapy (77 Church St), Professional Physical Therapy (303 George St), SportsMed Physical Therapy (207 Livingston Ave), Great Expressions Dental Centers (716 Livingston Ave), Affordable Dentures Middlesex County (154 French St), Hand & Stone, Massage Envy, Aspen Dental, and CrossFit Stealth New Brunswick (401 Jersey Ave) - a CrossFit-brand affiliate, removed this round under the franchise rule.

Rule applied to network brands: a branded franchise (the CrossFit affiliate) is excluded; a physician-owned management network is not. That is why Axis Family Care (Advocare) is retained with a flag while CrossFit Stealth was dropped. Triage can reverse either under one consistent rule.

Rutgers and RWJBarnabas entities excluded per the hospital/large-health-system and public-institution exclusions: Eric B. Chandler Health Center (277 George St, now a Rutgers Health location - removed this round), Rutgers Health University Dental Associates (135 Somerset St), Rutgers Health Family Medicine at Monument Square (317 George St), Rutgers Health Department of Pediatrics (89 French St), RWJ Physical Therapy and RWJ Fitness & Wellness Center (100 Kirkpatrick St), Saint Peter's Family Health Center (123 How Lane), College Avenue Gym / Cook-Douglass Recreation Center / Rutgers Fitness Center.

Dental names whose only listed address is a Rutgers/excluded site were not added: Wonseok Jang DDS (Rutgers Health University Dental Associates, 135 Somerset St), Salim Nathoo DDS (277 George St, the Eric B. Chandler building), the 'Dental Implants & Surgery' listing (135 Somerset St, the Rutgers dental faculty practice) and Kim Ken K DDS (1 Robert Wood Johnson Pl, hospital campus).

Two entries are indexed by the New Brunswick dental directory but physically in North Brunswick: CosmicSmiles Dental (1440 How Lane) and Dental Health Associates (977 Livingston Ave). They are kept because they are inside the 10-mile radius, with the town recorded honestly; drop them if the zone is strictly the town.

Several cosmetic/beauty entries come from bulk directories (BestProsInTown, HairSalonDirectories, NailSalonAtlas, HairBraidingAtlas, SuperPages) and are marked 'one directory listing' - these are small storefronts whose only web presence is a map profile. Triage should confirm they are still trading.

Duplicate/merge decisions made this round: True Cuts is now one entry with both New Brunswick storefronts; Confident Smiles and Livingston Avenue Dental are merged into one entry (same address and phone, two trading names); Lanny Rubin, DDS is folded into University Dental Care where he appears on a provider page; Brunswick Health & Physical Therapy Center and 'Brunswick Health Center' at 151 Livingston Ave remain one entry.

Unverified items are flagged in the entries themselves: Luminous Aesthetic's address/phone, Garden of Healing Yoga's operating status, Swagger Barber Shop's 43 Georges Rd address, Planeta Nuevo's 43 vs 58 Georges Rd, Organic Nails & Spa's address/phone (directory index only), Prestige Salon And Barbershop's current name, and the unnamed chiropractic office at 330 Livingston Ave Ste 3.
No website was recorded unless it was opened or seen linked from a listing; many small salons have only a Google/Facebook presence, so blank website fields are expected rather than an error.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap/Overpass API was unreachable (406 / timeouts), so no OSM cross-check was possible.

Yellow Pages, SuperPages, Manta, Cylex, LocalityBiz, Salondiscover and Localsolution all return 403 or Cloudflare blocks from here (tested both by fetching and with the real Chrome browser), so phone-book-only salons such as New Star Salon and Organic Nails & Spa rest on search-indexed listings rather than pages opened directly.

DentistsRanked's city page loaded, but every individual clinic profile returned HTTP 429 and the site throws a Vercel bot checkpoint in Chrome, so the street addresses in that directory could not be read from its own profiles and were taken from other sources (WebMD, CareCredit, own sites, NPI registries, insurer PDFs).

Andrea Elchoness, DDS appears in the New Brunswick dental directory but no street address or phone could be found on any page that would load, so she is not listed. Likewise 'New Brunswick Dental Associates' could not be matched to a distinct practice (the nearest match, Brunswick Dental Associates, is already listed at 374 Livingston Ave).

Luz M. Nieto, DDS is listed in the New Brunswick dental directory but her practice address is in North Plainfield; Lealon Robinson, DMD (oral surgeon) resolves to Newark and Boonton addresses; Dr. Kishor Kulkarni's KK Dental offices are in North Brunswick, Somerset and Edison. None was added.

Heavenly Hands Massage (49 Bayard St, 732-253-0108) could not be confirmed: it has no live booking profile, one directory marks it closed, and 49 Bayard St is now listed for Resilience Wellness Studio. Omitted rather than guessed.

Plastic Surgery Arts of New Jersey advertises a New Brunswick (409 Joyce Kilmer Ave) Botox service but its own website lists only Edison, East Brunswick, Princeton and Skillman locations; the New Brunswick address could not be confirmed on an opened page, so it was not added.
nj.luminousam.com does not resolve from here and the brand site's Botox page does not print the New Jersey address, so Luminous Aesthetic's address and phone remain unconfirmed.

The City of New Brunswick / New Brunswick City Center business directory (newbrunswick.com) still could not be parsed, so the official downtown BID member list was not reviewed - the best remaining source for completeness.
No licensing registry (NJ Division of Consumer Affairs cosmetology/dental boards) was queried; that would confirm counts of licensed salons and dental offices by address.
Google Maps renders only about 5 results per query in this browser profile, and both Google and Bing map listings are map-derived rather than audited, so category sweeps through maps remain partial.
